rows.grounds: accusative singular of dvārarodhana 'blocking of the gate'

items.question: What did the approaching warriors learn about the demon army's readiness at the gate?
premises: They had judged direct entry impossible.
They learned demon army's preparation and gate-blocking.
items.inference: The gate is fortified by prepared demon forces.
uncertainties: sannāhaṃ may mean armament rather than general preparation.
items.plain_english: Having learned of the demon army's preparation and the blocking of the gate.
